art.brief: Cinematic 16:9 hand-painted anime visual novel background. Mondstadt-inspired medieval stone bridge, reflective canal, warm lanterns, windmills and cathedral at blue-hour dusk. Navy, jade, gold. No people, text or UI.

Transparent original fan illustration of Venti, black hair with teal braids, green beret and cape, white blouse, lyre, playful smile, slightly facing viewer's right. Detailed 2D anime, teal rim lighting, uncropped head and arms.

Transparent original fan illustration of Lumine, blonde hair, amber eyes, white flowers and white-blue-gold dress, thoughtful expression, slightly facing viewer's left. Detailed 2D anime, teal rim lighting, uncropped head and arms.
